provisionalPathBudget.partitionRule: Each implementation PR remains within the repository default 15-file and 1200-line budget; source and deployment boundaries may use successor PRs under this one task.

ownerIntent.requestedOutcome: Close the seven evidence-backed pre-activation blockers as one finite RFGC program with Premium authority and discovery/event/Home repair groups.
ownerIntent.authorization: Level C source and test work plus bounded Level D forward migrations, exact affected Edge deployment, positively identified fixture quarantine, internal-v2 OTA, and sandbox-only provider correction when proven necessary.
prohibitedOutcomes: fabricated entitlement, role, Live, Event, pass, Circle relationship, balance, or provider transaction
weakened authentication, provider identity binding, RLS, or privacy authority

groups.name: PREMIUM_PROVIDER_BACKEND_AUTHORITY_CONVERGENCE
groups.boundary: Signed Apple and RevenueCat current-owner authority through idempotent backend projection and every Premium consumer without cross-user transfer.

groups.name: DISCOVERY_EVENT_HOME_RELEASE_READINESS
groups.boundary: Server-authoritative Live, Circle, Watch-Party and Event discovery, lifecycle and privacy; release-facing Home parity, polish, accessibility and internal-v2 manifest correctness.

deploymentSequence: apply only exact forward successor migrations
deploy only exact affected merged Edge Functions
publish one coherent compatible internal-v2 OTA per affected platform when required
restart the affected physical matrix from the beginning

nonGoals: restart Production Polish or previously closed programs
change unrelated hardened commerce, call, settlement, reserve, or payout systems
native build unless compatibility proves one is required
invariants: Provider entitlement projection binds the exact authenticated RevenueCat App User ID and current signed store authority.
TRANSFER is never a generic entitlement grant and RENEWAL never bypasses conflicting current-owner authority.
Only server-authoritative lifecycle transitions publish or retire discovery state.
Public, Circle, private, draft, canceled and ended visibility is enforced at the database boundary.
Clients cannot forge creator, room, event, target, visibility or active state.
Production-facing discovery excludes positively identified QA fixtures without deleting immutable financial or provider evidence.
Money, payouts and cashout remain fail-closed throughout this task.

rollback.strategy: Forward-only corrections, exact Edge version rollback, internal-v2 OTA rollback compatibility, and reversible fixture quarantine where supported.

cleanup.strategy: Quarantine or unpublish only exact positively identified QA/proof records after reference and ownership readback.

observability.strategy: Redacted exact-source, deployment and lifecycle receipts; no secrets, raw provider payloads, private screenshots, signed URLs, account IDs or device IDs in Git.
